proposal_metadata.purpose: Define an explicit, zero-copy, in-memory transport reference adapter for historical fluid-only references to allow unchanged canonical label operators to run without schema modification, file patching, or fabricated fixed particles.

historical_spatial_references_cohort.qi_qualification_barrier: Source H5 contains fluid particles only; lacks native fixed particles and full-typed axis attributes (initial_type, initial_mass); cannot pass full-typed Q-I without an adapter.
Source H5 contains fluid particles only; lacks native fixed particles and full-typed axis attributes (initial_type, initial_mass); cannot pass full-typed Q-I without an adapter.

strict_non_claim_boundaries.no_invented_fixed_particles: The adapter MUST NOT fabricate dummy fixed particles, static boundary rows, or fictitious wall trajectories. Fixed particles were never recorded in the fluid-only continuation files and shall not be simulated or claimed.
strict_non_claim_boundaries.no_assumed_unknown_fate: Unobserved particles MUST remain right-censored under registered observation semantics. No particle shall be classified as exited, lost, or relocated without direct native geometric evidence.
strict_non_claim_boundaries.no_consumed_h5_patching: The consumed immutable HDF5 continuation files on disk MUST NOT be modified, rewritten, overwritten, or in-place patched.
strict_non_claim_boundaries.no_schema_enrichment_without_root_review: No new dataset schema versions, ad-hoc attributes, or modified HDF5 contracts shall be persisted without explicit Codex root review and approval.
strict_non_claim_boundaries.no_materialized_trajectory_or_labels_bef: Strict non-materialization disclaimer: Under no circumstances shall enriched trajectory HDF5 files or transport label files be materialized or generated on disk using this adapter prior to formal Codex root review and sign-off.
strict_non_claim_boundaries.scientific_boundary: This adapter provides transport-reference-only memory virtualization. It does NOT confer full-typed Q-I status, Q-N qualification, or production eligibility to the fluid-only historical references.

memory_adapter_specification.architecture: Zero-copy in-memory wrapper / duck-typing layer around native h5py.File

position.semantics: direct pass-through of native Cartesian coordinates

valid.semantics: direct pass-through of native solver validity flag

type.semantics: indicates fluid identity (Type 3) across all frames; avoids synthesizing Type 0 fixed rows

mass.semantics: exact GenCase physical MassFluid in kg; no normalization or rescaling

time.semantics: direct pass-through of physical simulation timestamps

particle_id.semantics: binds the exact GenCase fluid particle IDs (61908..88527 for R0081818, 111708..179207 for REF-006)

operator_compatibility.f3_legacy_plain_full_transport_config: 100% compatible; source regions partition initial fluid positions at frame 0 into Left (x < 0) and Right (x >= 0)
operator_compatibility.f3_legacy_plain_operators: 100% compatible; finite interface x=0 exchange and z=0.51 open-exit diagnostic computed identically
operator_compatibility.output_labels_h5: Emits typed-transport-labels.h5 with n_particles=n_fluid, initial_fluid_mass_kg=14.58 kg, and complete transport/censoring ledgers

root_review_recommendation: Adopt this memory adapter in a dedicated scoped module (e.g. audit/f3_fluid_only_transport_adapter_v1.py) when root authorizes spatial convergence comparisons (dp=0.0075 vs dp=0.0081818 vs dp=0.006). Keep source HDF5 files strictly read-only.
